name: Instant Brain
original_name: インスタントブレイン
source:
Instant Brain is set in the near future and is centered around the idol industry, which the player sees through Zenya's eyes. Zenya lost his memories and to find clues to his past he uses his camera. His camera is called the "exposer" and the power of this camera allows him to get scoops before other reporters. While he is working as a paparazzi, he's using his camera to discover himself.

(adapted from [url=http://www.siliconera.com/2011/11/10/cave-talks-instant-brain-and-how-to-make-xbox-360-successful-in-japan/]an interview on Siliconera[/url])

Includes "Dodonpachi" and "Brain2Jump" as unlockable extra games.
translation:
《Instant Brain》设定在近未来，以偶像产业为中心，玩家通过禅也的视角来观察。禅也失去了记忆，为了找到关于自己过去的线索，他使用他的相机。他的相机叫做"曝光器"，这台相机的力量让他能比其他记者更早获得独家新闻。在做狗仔队工作的同时，他用相机来发现自己。

（改编自[url=http://www.siliconera.com/2011/11/10/cave-talks-instant-brain-and-how-to-make-xbox-360-successful-in-japan/]Siliconera的一次采访[/url]）

收录了"怒首领蜂"和"Brain2Jump"作为可解锁的额外游戏。
